title: Few low-degree vertices force a $K_4$-subdivision
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on at least four vertices in which at most one vertex has degree less than $3$. Then $G$ contains a subdivision of $K_4$.
hypotheses_covered: at most one vertex of degree less than 3
replaced:
\emph{ (B\&M \S{}8.3, verbatim).  }Show that if \texttt{G} is simple and has at
most one vertex of degree less than three, then \texttt{G} contains a subdivision of
\texttt{K$_{4}$}.*
